'''Mare Tino My Kind Of Musicians''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Mare Tino]]
* '''Published:''' 15 August 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|JPSD-D-mykindofscum.gif|label=My Kind Of Scum}}
* '''Strategy:''' My Kind Of Scum
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 MKOS Tino DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Battle and retrieve with great battle destinies.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

Your Rep is Greeata. Get Ak-Rev to the Chamber fast and he can get Greeata. Greeata (who is a Rodian) can get you the non-unique Rodian.

With Scum & Villainy and Greeata, you musicians are deploy -2 and forfeit +3. This means that Arica is now the ultimate attack squad. She is deploy 3 and forfeit 10. If he barriers her then you let her undercover and await your next turn.

Setup, drain, get 1 or 2 strike teams in your hand and beat him down.

If you're playing a space deck, you can go to space, just fill your (capital) ships with musicians and other special guests. If space is important you should get Jabba in his Cruiser with Boelo and some pilots. (Best setup I've got was Cruiser with ORS, Boba BH, Jabba, Boelo, IG-88 and Guri, that's a power 11 + 4 battle dests and opponent no battle destinies).

Cease Fire, cancels Proficiency and prevents opponent from slashing you to death.
